origin: Proposed synthetic operation map and semantic review challenges, not inspected production code.

ruleComparison.generation: Actual current owner at the reused address.
ruleComparison.token: Generation for which the request was cleared; immutable across replacement.
ruleComparison.pinnedMeaning: Deliberately weaker candidate property observes only token, ignoring actual current ownership.
ruleComparison.afterDeath: Completion by a surviving effect service after sender death, allowed when generation is unchanged.
ruleComparison.policyFindingOrigin: Author semantic judgment, not automatic byte-diff interpretation.

controlComparison.GuardA: Effect-time comparison of token and authoritative generation.
controlComparison.GuardB: Separate admission guard that prevents replacement while the cleared action exists.
controlComparison.OmitAudit: Non-safety bookkeeping mutation for the survived example; not a removed generation guard.
controlComparison.NoHazard: Negated reachability query token = generation; a violation witnesses replacement, not a safety failure.
controlComparison.NoAuditLoss: Unrelated property, deliberately invalid when substituted for the target safety rule.

actions.operation: Stop sender without clearing its already-cleared request.
Reassign the reusable address to a new generation. In the control model, GuardB disables this operation.
Resolve the reusable address and apply the cleared effect. GuardA, when enabled, compares authoritative current generation in that same effect operation.
actions.protectedInterval: GuardA must serialize generation comparison and effect with every reassignment; this is an explicit synthetic assumption.

actions.operation: Reject stale clearance without changing the replacement.

omissions: No actual database, immutable-object API, lock service, transport or restart implementation.
No classifier implementation or automatic reviewer is introduced; these are expected answer inputs for later workflow steps.
BrokenControl is intentionally malformed and must be invoked only as the parser-invalid control.
The not-run example has no invocation or fabricated checker evidence.
